test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Six friends U, V, W, X, Y, and Z are sitting in a circular arrangement and all are facing outside the circle. W is sitting to the immediate left of X and is second to the right of Y. X is sitting to the immediate left of Z. V is not an immediate neighbour of W. Who among the following is sitting to the immediate left of U?
solution:
Given: Six friends U, V, W, X, Y, and Z all are facing outside the circle.

1) W is sitting to the immediate left of X and is second to the right of Y.

2) X is sitting to the immediate left of Z.

3) V is not an immediate neighbour of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85e37564d2024f36e14986cbd11c526874e6a9f2a4a0bcf6c08ac143f49f0e4f.png] 

So, **Y** is sitting to the immediate left of U.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
